2842-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2645-3430-4644-5873.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4644-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2445-5254-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-5254-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

301-1453-2813.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-1453-2813.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6136-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6136-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6136-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4365-5660-6441-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2595-4050--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2

774-3147-6763.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Azorius Chancery's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

856-2981-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-4785.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2034-5078-5741-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

4050-5010-5447-7028.notablePrerequisites: You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
4050-5010-5447-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2173-4195-4574-4708.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Resolve the Dark Sphere ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3771-6867-6869.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
3771-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.
3771-6867-6869.notes: You can perform this combo if Animar has fewer +1/+1 counters on it. If Animar has exactly one counter, add {1} to the mana cost. If Animar has no counters, add {3} to the mana cost.

2645-3918-4045.description:
Activate Trazyn using Ur-Golem's Eye's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3918-4045.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

3394-3490-4050-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3394-3490-4050-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
When the Servo dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1567-2493.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
372-1567-2493.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

920-1309-1987-5195.description:
Activate Kaza by tapping it, causing the next instant or sorcery spell you cast to cost at least {2} less.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets and Kaza.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Kaza and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1722-2440-3287.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Tentacles.
You control at least one additional creature.
1722-2440-3287.description:
Activate Carnage Altar by paying {3} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

155-2034-2640-3136-3225.notablePrerequisites: Smoke Shroud attached to Changeling Outcast.
155-2034-2640-3136-3225.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Changeling Outcast, adding {C}{C}.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Changeling Outcast from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Changeling Outcast for {0}.
Smoke Shroud triggers, returning from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Changeling Outcast.
Repeat.

864-933-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
